proposed_smallest_change.expected_negative_assertion: Any direct, aliased, or statically resolvable dynamic import of actions._* in any installed Runtime Python module fails the installed-wheel compatibility test, even if that module is never imported during the smoke test.
proposed_smallest_change.expected_positive_assertion: Current public ActionContext import and Runtime-owned actions.server._protocols JSONValue remain accepted in installed clean-wheel environments.
regressions: Synthetic tree traversal catches forbidden import forms outside the imported-module subset.
A deliberately mismatched installed member versus selected wheel entry is rejected as artifact/member mismatch.
No forbidden references in every source member of each selected installed Runtime wheel, with wheel digest and member SHA256s retained.
test_design: Reuse _private_core_imports; add a tree-level regression with a synthetic installed Runtime root containing direct, aliased, and static dynamic actions._* imports in a non-imported extra module, and prove the tree traversal fails on that module.

In each existing clean wheel environment, enumerate every .py file in importlib.metadata.distribution('actions-runtime').files, resolve it under the clean environment, and fail if any Runtime source path is outside that environment or resolves into the checkout.

Bind the scan to the exact selected Runtime wheel: record wheel SHA256, compare each installed .py member's bytes/hash with the corresponding member in that exact wheel, and include the wheel identity and member path/hash inventory in the probe result. Do not treat package version alone or source checkout identity as artifact identity.

Apply _private_core_imports to every installed Runtime .py member and report offending member paths/lines; assert the complete member set was scanned, including modules never imported by the positive probe.

Keep current clean-wheel positive checks for public ActionContext/Request/server integration behavior, package origins, dependency consistency, and both Core/Runtime uninstall orders. Emit the same scan evidence for each fresh environment.
